A web address (Eeva V1 board 3b): the field shell with a leading link icon. The value reads in the accent text colour in every state; on error the icon turns red too, with no text (Eeva V1: no inline errors).

**Use:** CTA link, any URL the request points at.

**Avoid:** Not for free text. Validation belongs to the caller; this only shows the result.

**Variants:** error

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `boolean` | no |  |
